fields.description:
## Outcome and context

BUILD-202 (BA-1, WAGR-176) added Primary Market and Secondary Markets fields to the BA object but left the field type and value list open — "not yet settled." Emily's feedback settles it: Primary Market and Secondary Market picklist values should be Ontario, Alberta, USA.

## Current state

Primary Market (single-select) and Secondary Markets (multi-select, per BUILD-202) exist on the BA object with no confirmed value list. It's also not yet confirmed whether these should be new fields or reuse an existing value set — BUILD-202 notes "not confirmed these fields exist on the User object today — may need to be created."

## Proposed solution

1. Set the Primary Market and Secondary Market(s) picklist values to Ontario, Alberta, USA.
2. Check whether the existing WT_Market global value set (built in POC-05, WAGR-302) already contains these three values in a usable form, and reuse it rather than creating a second, separate value list if so.
3. Confirm field placement (BA object vs. User object) per the open question carried from BUILD-202.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Primary Market on BA offers exactly Ontario, Alberta, USA as selectable values.
2. Secondary Market(s) on BA offers the same three values, multi-select.
3. No duplicate/separate value set is created if the existing WT_Market set can be reused.

## Dependencies

Depends on BUILD-202 — Brand Ambassador: Object + Core Status (WAGR-176).

## Source

Wagertech Notes / Questions (Emily Vandenberg), reviewed Sep 2026: "Primary market and secondary market picklist values = Ontario, Alberta, USA." https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ShxHdE6kxblGnih7VQzXbBx1eL0sC6XAD-fk8H6V9yw/edit?tab=t.0
